result.topic_en: Gauss writes φ(7.5+x) as a cubic polynomial in x with undetermined coefficients α and β, sets up linear conditions on them, settles on a quadratic approximation, and then estimates its root by dividing the constant term by the difference of the other coefficients.

methods.what: Cubic polynomial expansion of φ about 7.5 with undetermined coefficients α, β
Linear equations for determining coefficients α, β from conditions
Root estimate of the quadratic via x ≈ c/(b − a), i.e. the constant term divided by the difference of the linear and quadratic coefficients
Long division producing digits of the quotient
